title: Partnership model: team declarations in game definitions
description:
Add partnerships field to game schema. Minimal: array of player arrays declaring teams.

```json
"partnerships": [
  ["North", "South"],
  ["East", "West"]
]
```

Engine uses it for:
- End conditions: winning entity is a team, not individual
- Shared counters: per_partnership counter zones (shared trick count, shared score)
- Win/loss propagation: one partner's win triggers whole team

Handles all team structures:
- Fixed 2v2: Bridge, Euchre, Spades, Tichu
- Asymmetric: Scotland Yard ([["Mr_X"], ["D1","D2"]])
- Full cooperative: Pandemic ([["medic","scientist"]])
- 3+ teams: [["A","B"], ["C","D"], ["E","F"]]

Partnerships are a declaration, not a mechanic. Cross-partner actions (declarer plays dummy, pass to partner) are game-specific logic in rules/phases/Felt. The engine just needs to know who's on whose team.

Deliverables: (1) Schema: partnerships field. (2) Engine: partnership-aware end conditions. (3) Engine: per_partnership counter zones. (4) Update Bridge definition to use partnerships. (5) Tests.
